name: mp-clipflow
description: MP ClipFlow — платформа автоматизации TikTok-контента с рекламными баннерами. Created by MP Production.
author: MP Production

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @clipflow/server & npm run dev -w @clipflow/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @clipflow/web && npm run build -w @clipflow/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @clipflow/shared && npm run test -w @clipflow/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @clipflow/shared && npm run typecheck -w @clipflow/server && npm run typecheck -w @clipflow/web
